regions.merged_text: "Hope though inferior to charity is superior to faith ..... Faith reveals God to us that we may turn to Him, but hope tends to unite us with Him, and charity actually effects this union, which is the supreme aim of all Christian life". Chief Sufferings (211) He that hath mercy on the poor lendeth to the Lord and He will repay him. (Prov. XIX 17.) "He looketh upon the earth and maketh it tremble. He toucheth the mountains and they smoke"Ps III-32. "For woe is unto me if I preach not the gospel" (I Cor. IX 16).

regions.merged_text: At Death of a Holy Religious. Rom. XIII 12 The night is passed .... day at hand Ps. LXXXIX We have rejoiced according to former affliction Poverty -e.g. Sr. Therese p. 116-17 Ps. 144 Gratitude-I will extoll Thee O God my King, and will bless Thy name for ever, yea for ever and ever. The Lord is gracious and merciful ... The Lord is sweet to all; and His tender mercies are over all his works.
